```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(openxlsx)
library(presto)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(ggplot2)

dir <- "Results/3FindMarkers"
dir.inf <- file.path(dir, "infected_comp")
dir.resinf <- file.path(dir, "Res_infected_comp")

dir.create(dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(dir.inf, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(dir.resinf, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

p_value <- 0.05

mac <- readRDS("Results/2_Integration/mac.RDS")
DefaultAssay(mac) <- "RNA"

mac <- NormalizeData(mac, normalization.method = "LogNormalize")

A <- subset(mac, subset = condition == "A")
B <- subset(mac, subset = condition == "B")
C <- subset(mac, subset = condition == "C")
D <- subset(mac, subset = condition == "D")

infected <- subset(mac, subset = treatment == "infected")
steady <- subset(mac, subset = treatment == "steady")
WT <- subset(mac, subset = genotype == "WT")
Irf8ko <- subset(mac, subset = genotype == "Irf8ko")

```


# per condition
```{r}
condition_objects <- list(
  A = A,
  B = B,
  C = C,
  D = D
)

condition_labels <- c(
  A = "WT_steady_markers",
  B = "WT_infected_markers",
  C = "Irf8_steady_markers",
  D = "Irf8_infected_markers"
)

condition_markers <- lapply(names(condition_objects), function(cond) {
  markers <- FindAllMarkers(
    condition_objects[[cond]],
    only.pos = TRUE,
    min.pct = 0.25,
    logfc.threshold = 0.25
  )
  
  markers <- markers |>
    filter(p_val_adj < p_value) |>
    arrange(cluster, desc(avg_log2FC))
  
  write.xlsx(
    markers,
    file = file.path(dir, paste0(condition_labels[[cond]], ".xlsx")),
    rowNames = FALSE
  )
  
  markers
})

names(condition_markers) <- names(condition_objects)

sign.A.markers <- condition_markers$A
sign.B.markers <- condition_markers$B
sign.C.markers <- condition_markers$C
sign.D.markers <- condition_markers$D
```

#generate single excel with separate sheets
```{r}
wb <- createWorkbook()

marker_sheets <- list(
  WT_steady_markers = sign.A.markers,
  WT_infected_markers = sign.B.markers,
  Irf8_steady_markers = sign.C.markers,
  Irf8_infected_markers = sign.D.markers
)

for (sheet_name in names(marker_sheets)) {
  addWorksheet(wb, sheet_name)
  writeData(wb, sheet_name, marker_sheets[[sheet_name]])
}

saveWorkbook(
  wb,
  file = file.path(dir, "Supp_table_6_markers_infection.xlsx"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

```

#heatmap
```{r}
colors <- c(
  "#a6cee3", "#1f78b4", "#b2df8a", "#33a02c", "#e31a1c", "#ff7f00",
  "#cab2d6", "#6a3d9a", "#ffff99", "#b15928", "#fb9a99", "#005F6A",
  "#FF70AB", "#640D6B", "#A0DEFF", "#E65C19", "#F8D082"
)

marker_lists <- list(
  A = sign.A.markers,
  B = sign.B.markers,
  C = sign.C.markers,
  D = sign.D.markers
)

object_lists <- list(
  A = A,
  B = B,
  C = C,
  D = D
)

for (cond in names(marker_lists)) {
  top_markers <- marker_lists[[cond]] |>
    group_by(cluster) |>
    slice_max(order_by = avg_log2FC, n = 5) |>
    ungroup()
  
  genes_use <- unique(top_markers$gene)
  
  p <- DoHeatmap(
    object_lists[[cond]],
    features = genes_use,
    group.colors = colors
  ) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(colors = rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n = 10, name = "RdBu")))
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(dir, paste0("Heatmap.", cond, ".png")),
    plot = p,
    height = 8,
    width = 10,
    dpi = 600
  )
}
```

#compare infected
```{r}
infected$cluster.condition <- paste(Idents(infected), infected$genotype, sep = "_")
Idents(infected) <- "cluster.condition"

marker_cluster_infected <- function(object, cluster_number, p_value, outdir) {
  ident_1 <- paste(cluster_number, "WT", sep = "_")
  ident_2 <- paste(cluster_number, "Irf8ko", sep = "_")
  
  message("Comparing identities: ", ident_1, " vs ", ident_2)
  
  idents_present <- c(ident_1, ident_2) %in% levels(Idents(object))
  if (!all(idents_present)) {
    warning("Skipping cluster ", cluster_number, " because one or both identities are absent.")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  markers <- FindMarkers(
    object,
    ident.1 = ident_1,
    ident.2 = ident_2,
    only.pos = TRUE,
    min.pct = 0.25,
    logfc.threshold = 0.5
  )
  
  markers <- tibble(gene = rownames(markers), markers) |>
    filter(p_val_adj < p_value) |>
    arrange(desc(avg_log2FC))
  
  write.xlsx(
    markers,
    file = file.path(outdir, paste0("inf.cl", cluster_number, ".xlsx")),
    rowNames = FALSE
  )
  
  markers
}

infected_cluster_markers <- setNames(
  lapply(0:13, function(i) marker_cluster_infected(infected, i, p_value, dir.inf)),
  paste0("cl", 0:13)
)
```
